text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Monday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- Ten presidents from East and Central Europe will attend a conference on good neighbourly relations scheduled for the beginning of September in Vilnius. Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin will also attend.

- The chairman of parliament Vytautas Landsbergis met the national director of the Anti-Defamation League Abraham Foxman who urged Lithuania to speed up the investigation of cases against suspected war criminals.
- Big block trades in pharmaceutical producer Sanitas and Hermis Bank last week indicate the start of a new bull run on the Vilnius bourse, experts said.
- Parliament will hold an extraordinary session today to vote on the prosecutor general's request to strip the immunity of MP Audrius Butkevichius, suspected of taking a bribe.
- The President of Estonia will start his first official visit to Lithuania on Wednesday.
- Lithuanian Savings Bank reported a 1.3 million litas net profit in July after 10.8 million litas in losses for the first half of the year.
- The country's depository said that the average price/earning (P/E) ratio of the country's enterprises listed on the Vilnius bourse was around 18 percent lower in August than in March.
- The Vilnius stock exchange registered a 20 million litas block trade involving around five percent of Hermis Bank's shares on Friday.
- Reh Holdings Limited firm representing Preussag Wasser & Rohrtehnik and Canadian IPL International Inc expressed their wish to buy into the new share issue of Butunge oil terminal.
- The state tax inspection said that the national budget revenue's in the first seven months of the year reachede 4.465 billion litas.
- Polish Kredyt bank S.A, which received permission to open a branch in Lithuania, cannot start its activities because of formal obstacles.
